description: This 2018 Honda CR-V EX presents a dependable choice for those seeking practical, everyday transportation with proven reliability and solid performance.  - 1.5L I4 DOHC 16V engine with CVT and AWD - Apple CarPlay/Android Auto integration - Power moonroof - Heated front bucket seats - Blind Spot Information (BSI) System warning - Exterior parking camera with rear view - Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C - 18" alloy wheels - Electronic Stability Control and traction control - Remote keyless entry - Steering wheel mounted audio controls - SiriusXM satellite radio - Four-wheel independent suspension - Factory warranty included  The CR-V delivers balanced efficiency with 27 city MPG and 33 highway MPG, making it suited for both daily commuting and longer drives. The all-wheel drive system provides confident handling in varied weather conditions, while the continuously variable transmission contributes to smooth acceleration and responsive driving dynamics.  Inside, the spacious cabin accommodates passengers with comfort-focused features including heated front bucket seats and a power moonroof that adds openness and natural light. The available split-folding rear seat expands cargo versatility for larger items, while the rear window wiper helps maintain visibility during inclement weather. The power driver seat allows personalized positioning for extended comfort.  Safety receives thorough attention with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. The Blind Spot Information System provides additional awareness, while four-wheel independent suspension, electronic stability control, and speed-sensing steering work together to enhance vehicle control and confidence on the road.
